shared_elements: costume elements with beaded or banded detail
justification: Both depict a frontally posed anthropomorphic personage rendered in low relief, with a large ornamented headdress above and a prominent disc/plaque pectoral centred on the chest, plus banded costume details—an arrangement of head-over-chest-ornament-over-garment that is broadly parallel. The biggest difference is that B is a densely packed figure with arms, hands holding implements, feathered or fringed lateral plumes and subsidiary faces, whereas A is a plain columnar body with no visible arms or attributes and only a few isolated motifs (disc, arcs, scrolls) on an otherwise blank surface.
